violation_type.title: Field Trips - Emergency Medical Forms (26 TAC §747.2901(a)(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: Three children emergency medical forms were not in the transportation binder when licensing staff reviewed the binder.

finding_variants.text: Three children emergency medical forms were not in the transportation binder when licensing staff reviewed the binder.
Operation conducted a field trip during the month of April 2023.  Emergency medical consent forms and first aid kit were not taken during the field trip.

It was observed that the operation was on a field trip at the park located across the street and director did not have emergency medical forms and emergency contact information for the three children in care.     Note:  Corrected at inspection when provider gathered the information.
The operation was on a field trip without the signed emergency medical consent forms for the children in care.
